title: DiscoX: Benchmarking Discourse-Level Translation task in Expert Domains
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the translation capabilities of LLMs across various specialized domains such as natural sciences, law, and literature. Although some evaluation tasks include translating religious or spiritual texts (e.g., Zen Buddhism in the Humanities domain), the core evaluation is based on translation accuracy, fluency, and stylistic appropriateness rather than an assessment of religious beliefs, morals, or ethics.
